description:
The Baby Sitters Club Kristy's Great Idea audio book for kids

Kristy, Mary Anne, Claudia and Stacey are the best friends and founding members of The Baby-Sitters Club. Whatever comes up-cranky toddlers, huge dogs, scary neighbors, prank calls - you can count on them to save the day. Baby-sitting is not always easy, and neither is dealing with strict parents, new families, fashion emergencies, and mysterious secrets. But no matter what, the BSC have what they need most: friendship.

description:
The baby-sitters club. Book 3: Mary Anne Save the Day. Audiobook for kids

When The Baby-sitters Club gets into a huge fight, Mary Anne is left to her own devices. She has to eat by herself in the school cafeteria, figure out how to make new friends, and deal with her overprotective father. But the worst happens when she funds herself in a baby-sitting emergency and can`t turn to her friends for help. Will Mary Anne solve her problems and save The Baby-sitters Club from falling apart?

description:
Audiobook for kids,  The Baby-Sitters Club, book 4, Claudia and Mean Janine.

Claudia and her sister, Janine, may as well be from two different planets. Claudia, who pays more attention to her artwork and the Baby-Sitters Club`s new playgroup than her homework, feels like  
she can`t complete with her perfect sister. Janine studies nonstop, makes straight As, and even takes college-level courses. But when something unexpected happens to the most beloved part of  Claudia and Janine`s family, will the sisters be able to put aside their differences?

description:
The Baby-Sitters Club. Dawn and the Impossible Three. Audiobook for kids

Dawn Schafer is the newest member of the Baby-Sitters Club. Even though she`s still adjusting to life in Stoneybrook after moving from sunny California, she is eager to accept her first big job. But taking care of the three Barrett kids would be too much for any baby-sitter. The house is always a mess, the kids are out of control, and Mrs.Barrett never does any of the things she promises. On top of all that, Dawn wants to fit in with the other members of The BSC, but she can`t figure out how to get along with Kristy. Was joining The BSC a mistake?
